routing.instructions: Use the original 1914 scan, locate Example 250 (not printed page 250), and inspect its preceding and following pages for continuation and attribution. Do not substitute a modern reprint or familiar audio melody.

rightsEvidence.observed: IMSLP identifies the complete original book as Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1914, and explicitly labels its copyright Public Domain; file 285332 is an Internet Archive scan, 416 PDF pages.
